gaps.sentence: There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.

gaps.sentence: She gazed at the mural in silent ___ (ADMIRE).
gaps.explanation: 'In silent admiration' — the noun for the feeling.

gaps.sentence: The bridge is an ___ (IMPRESS) piece of engineering.
gaps.explanation: The bridge impresses people: it is impressive.

gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The ___ (LONG) of the film is 145 minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'The length' — noun from long (spelling change: long → length).

gaps.sentence: The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.

gaps.sentence: The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.

gaps.sentence: There's a growing ___ (AWARE) of mental health issues.
